entries.description: What an agent can read on pqp.gg without an account: public profiles, public communities, invite links, release notes and the source repository. pqp has no agent-facing API.
representativeQueries: show me the public profile pqp.gg/@rafa
what does a pqp community page at pqp.gg/c/valorant contain
is pqp open source and can I self-host it

entries.description: RFC 9727 linkset naming the pqp API origin and its live status document. Every API route requires a signed-in user session.
representativeQueries: where is the pqp API documented
